body_text:
Orbit--stabilizer theorem. If a finite group $G$ acts on a set
$X$, then for every $x\in X$ one has $|G|=|G\cdot x|\,|G_x|$. More
generally, the map $G/G_x\to G\cdot x$ given by
$gG_x\mapsto g\cdot x$ is a well-defined bijection.
